messages:
Jamie K: kicking off terraform apply for release/23.1 now. preflight finished, but provider upgrade check flagged the aws provider bump from 4.x -> 5.0 in modules/networking. anyone object to pinning to 4.76 for this change window?
Aaron P: quick summary of the risky diffs?
Jamie K: main changes: route53 delegations, two new IAM policies for cross-account logs, and a small TGW propagation flag. plan looked fine but provider change touches behaviour for kms/encryption defaults.
Mira S: +1 to pin to 4.76 for stability. We can schedule provider upgrade for next minor with more tests. :thumbsup:
Lina C: we should also canary the NAT route change to the canary-subnet first. avoid global apply.
infra-bot: terraform plan uploaded: https://internal-plans/release-23.1/plan-1778004321 (sha: 9b7f). Detected 3 resources to be replaced, 7 to be updated.
Aaron P: thanks infra-bot. I'll run an apply against the canary workspace (canary-subnet) first. planning window 30m.
Jamie K: to confirm, we'll pin provider in root module and modules/networking to = "~> 4.76" and re-run plan. who will commit the pin?
Aaron P: I'll push a tiny commit to infra/terraform: provider pin + README note. will add a fast rollback playbook in that commit.
Mira S: paste the rollback steps here too please. quick checklist: 1) revert commit 2) `terraform apply -target=module.networking` for the canary 3) follow incident channel if cross-account iam breaks.
Lina C: add a guard: set `max_parallelism = 1` for the canary apply and `-refresh=false` to reduce drift for now.
Aaron P: noted. commit pushed: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/commit/ab12cd3 (provider pin + rollback.md)
deploy-bot: Starting apply for workspace=canary-subnet by @aaron at 2026-10-02T14:12:05Z.
deploy-bot: stdout: 
```
Applying: module.networking.aws_route.nat (modified)
Applying: module.networking.aws_route_table_association.canary (created)
Error: resource creation failed: aws_kms_key.logging: missing required kms_key_policy entries
```
Jamie K: saw the error, looks like the KMS policy in the central logging account doesn't include the new principal. is this a policy drift or the plan missing something?
Mira S: checking logs now. looks like the policy document in secrets manager is out of sync. I can push a quick policy patch to add the principal.
Lina C: hold on apply until we confirm scope. don't want to accidentally open KMS to broader accounts.
Mira S: confirmed minimal principal added, policy validated locally. will attach and re-run policy check.
infra-bot: policy update deployed to staging: secret/logging/kms-policy -> version 4.
Aaron P: re-running apply for canary with max_parallelism=1.
deploy-bot: Starting apply for workspace=canary-subnet by @aaron at 2026-10-02T14:25:29Z.
deploy-bot: stdout: 
```
Apply complete: 0 to add, 6 to change, 0 to destroy.
```
Jamie K: canary looks healthy. metrics show no latencies spike and routes propagated.
Lina C: agree. let's schedule the broader apply to the change window at 16:00 UTC. keep provider pinned. Aaron, will you run the window apply?
Aaron P: yes. I'll run a staged apply: v1) regional stacks (us-east-1) v2) global routing v3) cross-account iam. will watch for KMS errors again.
Mira S: update rollback doc: if global apply fails, revert commit ab12cd3 and run `terraform apply -target=module.networking -var='region=us-east-1'` then escalate to oncall.
Jamie K: noted. set a 45m change window and a rollback-go/no-go checkpoint at 15m after start. Lina to own the checkpoint.
Lina C: will own. I'll drop a message in #incidents if anything looks off. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Starting apply for workspace=release-23.1 (global) by @aaron at 2026-10-02T16:00:12Z. provider pinned to 4.76 by lockfile.
deploy-bot: stdout: 
```
Applying: module.networking.aws_route_table_association.global (modified)
Applying: module.iam.aws_iam_policy.cross_account_logs (created)
Apply complete: 1 to add, 20 to change, 0 to destroy.
```
Aaron P: final checks passed, marking release/23.1 as deployed. created release note entry referencing the provider pin and follow-up upgrade ticket.
Jamie K: thanks everyone. follow-up action: schedule provider upgrade test matrix in staging and a canary for provider 5.x next sprint.
Mira S: added ticket INFRA-542: provider-upgrade-test-matrix.
Lina C: closing loop. :white_check_mark:
